subject: The Cloud Master hub renders the capstone TWICE, from two independent sources: a Labs card (ContentCatalog projection, components:['lab'] -> BUCKET.lab) and a Projects card (Firestore hubRegistry/cloud-master sections.projects, written by functions/register-capstone-project.js). Measured on production 2026-08-01: querySelectorAll('a[href*=project-iac]') returns 2, in sections Labs(27) and Projects(1), with DIFFERENT authored copy. ROOT CAUSE: merged(admin, projected) at _app/houses/hub/index.html:519-527 de-dups by href only WITHIN one section's call. Nothing de-dups ACROSS sections, so the same href can render in Labs and Projects simultaneously. This is the same class Chris blocked on 2026-07-30 ('a shelf that lists the same file twice reads as a data leak, not a curriculum') -- that fix added projection-wide href de-dup INSIDE the projection, but curated Firestore items bypass it. Any content curated into one section that is also catalogued into another will double-render.
